title: Workers SDK lifecycle follow-up and cross-review
purpose: Convert the Workers SDK lifecycle scout into three bounded, reviewable investigations without duplicate edits or unauthorized upstream contact.
exclusions: No upstream issues, pull requests, comments, reviews, reactions, or other contact.
No live production deployment or rollback without separate authorization.
No broad refactor that is not justified by a failing reproduction or bounded contract decision.
No worker edits to shared batch status, manifest, or synthesis files.

constraints.default_time_boundary: Return a bounded finding, negative result, or explicit blocker; stop before speculative expansion.

questions: Can cleanup failure skip or delay workerd termination?
When do Wrangler and Vite select different configuration?
What deployment state changes before a later failure?

assignments.question: Can an early rejection or unresolved cleanup operation prevent Runtime.dispose() from terminating workerd, especially under parallel Vitest execution?
assignments.method: source trace, failure injection, package-level regression testing, adversarial test review, and adjacent Vite lifecycle exploration
assignments.claim_to_support_or_falsify: Miniflare cleanup ordering contains a sufficient path for a hidden live workerd child after an otherwise passing Vitest run.
preferred_primary_sources: Workers SDK source at exact revisions
workerd process lifecycle source when needed
public upstream issues and pull requests as quiet references
assignments.deliverable: A focused Fieldwork result and PR with a real failing test or a precise feasibility limit, rejected alternatives, and a bounded repair direction.
dependencies: Package execution remains required before source integration.
Adjacent Vite container cleanup candidate #165 requires separate mocked plugin tests.
Adjacent Vite logical runtime ownership candidate #179 requires restart and multi-server integration tests across Vite 6, 7, and 8.
assignments.stop_condition: Stop when the lifecycle claim is reproduced, falsified, or blocked by a specific unavailable test dependency; do not generalize every teardown hang to this cause.
assignments.review_disposition: Mechanism accepted; kill assertions bind to the workerd child. Adjacent Vite container ownership is candidate #165 and process-wide runtime/restart/tunnel ownership is candidate #179; keep both separate from the first child-ownership patch and from primary-error aggregation.

assignments.question: Under which layouts and invocation modes do Wrangler, wrangler dev, Vite, and redirected deployment configuration select different files?
assignments.method: source trace, tightened prepared behaviour matrix, compatibility analysis, prior-art review, and formal cross-review
assignments.claim_to_support_or_falsify: Configuration selection differs across Wrangler and Vite in consequential but insufficiently explicit ways involving precedence, search boundaries, explicit paths, and deploy-config redirects.
preferred_primary_sources: Workers SDK source at exact revisions
public upstream issues and pull requests as quiet references
assignments.deliverable: A Fieldwork result and PR with a prepared executable selection matrix, intentional-versus-accidental classification, and the smallest coherent shared-policy API direction.
dependencies: Package execution and compatibility decision remain required before changing defaults.
assignments.stop_condition: Stop after the source dimensions and compatibility boundary are recorded and the package matrix is prepared; do not silently choose new defaults without execution and migration analysis.
assignments.review_disposition: Characterization accepted after direct JSONC/TOML and relative explicit-path controls; prefer shared policy disclosure before default alignment.

assignments.question: Which deployment mutations can succeed before Wrangler reports a later failure, and what state can be reported safely afterward?
assignments.method: mutation-order map, executed dependency-free failure and reporting-guard model, prepared package regression tests, state-reporting design, and formal cross-review
assignments.claim_to_support_or_falsify: Wrangler can fail after Worker activation or other mutations, while current output does not consistently identify the changed state, failed phase, or safe recovery actions.
preferred_primary_sources: Workers SDK deploy source at exact revisions
Cloudflare API response handling in source
public upstream reports as quiet references
assignments.deliverable: A Fieldwork result and PR with a deployment mutation table, post-activation failure tests or models, and a bounded journal/state-reporting proposal.
dependencies: Package execution and output-contract review remain required before applying the integration patch.
assignments.stop_condition: Stop at accurate guarded state reporting and recovery guidance; do not add automatic rollback unless resource-specific safety is demonstrated.
assignments.review_disposition: Guarded state-reporting direction accepted; reporting is best-effort, original error identity is authoritative, the refreshed model executed from retained identical content, and automatic rollback remains out of scope.

assignments.question: Which claims and proposed tests from A001-A003 survive independent reproduction, source review, and prior-art analysis?
assignments.method: independent reproduction, adversarial review, and prior-art audit
assignments.claim_to_support_or_falsify: The three candidate campaigns are distinct, reproducible, not already resolved, and bounded enough to justify implementation work.
preferred_primary_sources: A001-A003 final branches and result files
Workers SDK and workerd source at exact revisions
upstream issues, pull requests, commits, and changelogs as quiet references
assignments.deliverable: Originally planned independent review lane; duties redistributed to coordinator and peer review.
assignments.stop_condition: Withdrawn at user direction after the active batch was reduced.
assignments.review_disposition: Review duties redistributed; package execution remains an explicit shared gate.
